TFT11_Augment_TinyButDeadly.name: Tiny, but Deadly

TFT17_Augment_AnimaSquad_Commander.name: Anima Commander

TFT17_Augment_Arbiter_DivineAmendment.name: Divine Amendment

Arbiters add a second effect to their law.

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment.name: Aurelion Sol's Boon
TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment.desc:

TFT17_Augment_AurelionSolGodAugment_Boon.name: Boon of Resurrection

When the Black Hole consumes enemies, it turns them into space matter. After acquiring enough, the Black Hole turns it into loot! Gain a Cho'gath and a Lissandra.

TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.name: Ekko's Boon
TFT17_Augment_EkkoGodAugment.desc: Gain the Anomaly, an item which grants units a powerful evolution depending on their role. Gain @NumRemovers_TOOLTIPONLY@ Magnetic Removers.

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment.name: Evelynn's Boon

TFT17_Augment_EvelynnGodAugment_BloodPri.name: Blood Price

TFT17_Augment_GragasCarry.name: Self Destruct

TFT17_Augment_IvernMinionCarry.name: The Big Bang

TFT17_Augment_KayleGodAugment.name: Kayle's Boon

TFT_Augment_RestartMission.desc: Remove all champions on your board and bench. Gain @3Cost@ random 2-star 3-costs, @2Cost@ 2-star 2-costs, and @1Cost@ 2-star 1-cost champion.

TFT_Augment_Retribution.name: Retribution
TFT_Augment_Retribution.desc:
Gain @ItemCount@ Hands of Justice. Allies equipped with Hand of Justice gain Precision and @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance.

{{TFT_Keyword_Precision}}

TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount.name: Savings Account
TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount.desc:
After you earn @GoldRequired@ gold in interest, gain @GoldToGain@ gold. Your max interest is increased to @InterestCap@. Gain @GoldNow@ gold now.

Gold earned: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SavingsAccount_Tracker@

TFT_Augment_SeraphimsStaff.name: Seraphim's Staff
TFT_Augment_SeraphimsStaff.desc: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants @IncreasedMana@ additional Mana Regen if its holder has @APThreshold@% or more Ability Power.

TFT_Augment_ShimmerscaleEssence.name: Shimmerscale Essence
TFT_Augment_ShimmerscaleEssence.desc:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. In @combatnum@ rounds, gain a Gamblers Blade.

These items give gold as well as combat power.

TFT_Augment_SideEffects.name: Side Effects
TFT_Augment_SideEffects.desc: When an ally is healed, they deal @HealConversionPct*100@% of the healing to their target as magic damage. Every @HealInterval@ seconds, allies heal for @HealPct*100@% of their max Health.

TFT_Augment_SizeMatters.name: Size Matters
TFT_Augment_SizeMatters.desc: Gain a Giant's Belt. After a champion starts combat with more than @HealthRequired@ max Health, gain a Warmog's Armor.

TFT_Augment_SliceOfLife.name: Slice of Life
TFT_Augment_SliceOfLife.desc: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving @Max5Costs@ 5-cost champion.

TFT_Augment_SoloLeveling.name: Solo Leveling
TFT_Augment_SoloLeveling.desc: For the next @NumCombats@ combats, your team size is 1 but the champion you field has massively increased stats. Gain @XPPerKill@ XP for every kill they get. Afterwards, gain @NumComponents@ item components.

TFT_Augment_SpeedyDoubleKill.name: Speedy Double Kill
TFT_Augment_SpeedyDoubleKill.desc:
Gain a Guinsoo's Rageblade. When 2 players are eliminated, gain @GoldAmount@ gold.

Fates Championship, 2021

TFT_Augment_SpreadingRootsPlus.name: Spreading Roots+
TFT_Augment_SpreadingRootsPlus.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

TFT_Augment_SubscriptionService.name: Subscription Service
TFT_Augment_SubscriptionService.desc: Now and at the start of each Stage, open a Shop of 4 unique 4-cost champions and gain @GoldPerStage@ gold.

TFT_Augment_Survivor.name: Survivor
TFT_Augment_Survivor.desc: Gain @InitialGold@ gold. After @PlayersDead@ players are eliminated, gain @Gold@ more gold.

TFT_Augment_SweetTreats.name: Sweet Treats
TFT_Augment_SweetTreats.desc:
Gain an Artifact anvil. Your team gains @HealthPerItem@ Health for each item equipped on champions.

Health Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_SweetTreats_TeamHealth@

Magic N' Mayhem Tactician's Crown, 2024

TFT_Augment_SwordOverflow.name: Sword Overflow
TFT_Augment_SwordOverflow.desc: Gain @NumItems@ B.F. Swords. Your B.F. Swords grant +@BonusStat*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT_Augment_TacticiansKitchen.name: Tactician's Kitchen
TFT_Augment_TacticiansKitchen.desc: Gain a random Emblem. After @TurnDelay@ rounds, gain a Tactician's Cape.

TFT_Augment_TheBaronsLair.name: Baron's Lair
TFT_Augment_TheBaronsLair.desc:
Gain a random Tank item. After @StartSeconds@ seconds of combat, your team gains @Stats@% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.

TFT Paris Open, 2025

TFT_Augment_TheDarkinBlade.name: Blood Offering
TFT_Augment_TheDarkinBlade.desc: Gain a Bloodthirster. Combat start: Allies holding Bloodthirsters lose @HPLossPercent*100@% Health but gain a @HPShieldPercent*100@% Health shield and @BonusAD*100@% Attack Damage.

TFT_Augment_TheGoldenDragon.name: The Golden Dragon
TFT_Augment_TheGoldenDragon.desc:
Gain a Mogul's Mail. Champions holding Mogul's Mail take up 2 team slots but gain @BonusHealth@ Health and @DurabilityPct*100@% Durability.

Mogul's Mail gives gold as well as combat power.
Dragonlands Championship, 2022

TFT_Augment_TheTower.name: The Tower
TFT_Augment_TheTower.desc: Gain a giant Training Dummy with increased Health (increases with Stage). Every @ZapInterval@ seconds, it zaps the @ZapCount@ nearest enemies dealing @MaxHealthPct*100@% max Health true damage.

TFT_Augment_TheVidalion.name: Woven Magic
TFT_Augment_TheVidalion.desc:
Gain a random item component. Every @ManaPerComponent@ Mana your team spends grants an additional component (max @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_NumComponents@/@ComponentMax@).

Mana spent: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT_Augment_TheVidalion_TrackedMana@/@ManaPerComponent@

TFT_Augment_TragicalBlade.name: Deadlier Blades
TFT_Augment_TragicalBlade.desc: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain @AD*100@% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

TFT_Augment_TraitTree.name: The Trait Tree
TFT_Augment_TraitTree.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

TFT_Augment_TraitTreePlus.name: The Trait Tree+
TFT_Augment_TraitTreePlus.desc: Gain @NumOfEmblems@ random Emblems, a Reforger, and @Gold@ gold.

TFT_Augment_TreasureHunt.name: Treasure Hunt
TFT_Augment_TreasureHunt.desc: Gain a locked chest each Stage between now and Stage @MaxNumChests@. Unlock each chest when you spend @GoldNeededPerChest@ gold on Shop rerolls. These chests persist until opened.

TFT_Augment_Trifecta1.name: Trifecta I
TFT_Augment_Trifecta1.desc:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT_Augment_Trifecta2.name: Trifecta II
TFT_Augment_Trifecta2.desc:
Gain @numunits@ @Tier@-cost champions. Allies gain @TeamAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.
Combat Start: @BuffedNumber@ random @Tier@-cost champions gain @Health@ Health and @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT_Augment_TwinGuardians.name: Twin Guardians
TFT_Augment_TwinGuardians.desc: If you have exactly @NumUnits@ allies in your first row, grant them @BonusHealth@ bonus Health, @BonusAR@ Armor, and @BonusMR@ Magic Resist.

TFT_Augment_TwoMuchValue.name: Two Much Value
TFT_Augment_TwoMuchValue.desc: Gain @FreeRerolls@ reroll for every @UnitCount@ unique 2-cost champions fielded last player combat. Gain @NumChampsToGrant@ 2-cost champions.

TFT_Augment_TwoTanky.name: Two Tanky
TFT_Augment_TwoTanky.desc: When you field exactly 2 copies of a champion, they both gain @BonusHealth@ Health. When one copy dies, the other gains a @OnDeathPercHeal*100@% max Health Shield for @HealDuration@ seconds. When you 3-star, gain a 2-star copy.

TFT_Augment_Unforgotten.name: Warlord's Honor
TFT_Augment_Unforgotten.desc: Every round, your team gain @Stats@% Attack Damage and Ability Power. Champions start with @StartingStacks@ stack of this effect, and can stack up to @MaxStacks@ times.

TFT_Augment_UpwardMobility.name: Upward Mobility
TFT_Augment_UpwardMobility.desc: Buying XP costs 1 less. Gain @Health@ Health and @Rerolls@ free rerolls whenever you level up.

TFT_Augment_UrfsGambit.name: Urf's Gambit
TFT_Augment_UrfsGambit.desc: If you win your next player combat, gain a Spatula. If you lose, gain a Frying Pan. Gain a component anvil and @Gold@ gold now.

TFT_Augment_WandOverflow.name: Wand Overflow
TFT_Augment_WandOverflow.desc: Gain @NumItems@ Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +@BonusStat*100@% Attack Speed.

TFT_Augment_WarmogsBuckle.name: Heart of Steel
TFT_Augment_WarmogsBuckle.desc: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every @SecondsPerGain@ seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional @Health@ permanent max Health.

TFT_Augment_Warpath.name: Warpath
TFT_Augment_Warpath.desc:
Gain a 2-star 2-cost champion. After dealing @PlayerDamage@ player damage, gain a chest of high cost champions and items.
(Current: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_Warpath_DamageCount@)

TFT_Augment_Waverider.name: On a Roll
TFT_Augment_Waverider.desc: Whenever you star up a champion that you fielded last combat, gain @NumRolls@ free Shop rerolls. Gain @Gold@ gold.

TFT_Augment_WeStickTogether.name: We Stick Together
TFT_Augment_WeStickTogether.desc:
Gain a random Emblem and a completed item anvil. Allies that share a trait with that Emblem gain @ASPercent@% Attack Speed. @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WeStickTogether_Tooltip@

Into The Arcane Tactician's Crown, 2025

TFT_Augment_WinOut.name: Win Out
TFT_Augment_WinOut.desc: When you reach level 9, immediately level to 10 and gain @RerollCount@ free Shop rerolls. Gain @InstantXP@ XP now.

TFT_Augment_WorthTheWaitGold.name: Worth the Wait
TFT_Augment_WorthTheWaitGold.desc:
Gain a random @UnitTier@-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

Champion: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WorthTheWait@

TFT_Augment_WorthTheWaitPrismatic.name: Worth the Wait II
TFT_Augment_WorthTheWaitPrismatic.desc:
Gain @InitialCopies@ copies of a random @unittier@-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

Champion: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Augment_WorthTheWait@
